newsitem.title: USA: IMM currencies remain higher, yen backs off highs.
newsitem.headline: IMM currencies remain higher, yen backs off highs.

text.p: April 29 - IMM currency futures remained higher, with June yen backing off daily highs in light, choppy trade. June pesos were higher, but also edged off highs. Traders said more volume traded in pesos, than in yen. They estimated 6,500 peso contracts traded and 6,000 yen traded in the first several hours of pit trade. ((Chicago Derivatives Desk (312)408-8750/))
